description: Resolve a company name, ticker or CIK to its SEC identity. Returns {results, count}, up to 20 matches (hard cap); each result carries SEC-EDGAR-derivable identity fields only: ticker, companyName, cik, sicCode, exchange, fiscalYearEnd, tickerStatus (check it before treating a match as a live listing). A null field is OMITTED from the row, so never assume `cik` is present. Matching is a literal substring on ticker / companyName (plus the other class-share punctuation, and a digit-only CIK); former names and misspellings do NOT resolve. Once resolved, call get_fundamentals or get_business_summary. Source: Oxford Ledge company_profiles, restricted to the SEC-submissions column allowlist. Caveats ride the response's tool_notes.

query.description: Search query (company name, ticker, or industry)

name: search_company
